data.body:
## [6.0.6](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/compare/v6.0.5...v6.0.6) (2026-11-16)


### Bug Fixes

* **catalog:** select published EventStore 5.1.1 ([fd8ace6](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/fd8ace6e5f5107d44194f7822fafaceca3af5c01))
* **catalog:** select published Folders 2.0.0 ([801f268](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/801f268cd1b37ecae41d4fb20d115c055b4c5793))
* **ci:** align catalog compatibility expectations ([f0f5007](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/f0f5007cca1f9183d4f192e162071ba1c3282a63))
* **ci:** align evaluated EventStore expectations ([264e17d](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/264e17d3185c87b72b0757dd66a13040793756bb))
* **ci:** allow the full Builds suite to finish ([04bdcaf](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/04bdcaf929198e69321c226dda5ab40f7b3839ce))
* **release:** verify published packages before finalization ([65fd22f](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/commit/65fd22f37b9fad64b595841923cdbe050563ab99))
